exact_3min_demo.action: Click 'Start Guided SIH Judge Demo' button
exact_3min_demo.expected_result: Guided SIH Walkthrough Banner appears at top of screen.
exact_3min_demo.what_to_say: Respected Judges, welcome to Nexora TRAC RailRadar—our AI-powered train traffic control and real-time network optimization system.
exact_3min_demo.technical_meaning: Initializes guided demonstration state in React UI (isDemoMode = true, demoStep = 0).

exact_3min_demo.expected_result: Train Detail Modal opens displaying telemetry, speed (72 km/h), delay (1.0 min), and ML risk (12% LOW).
exact_3min_demo.what_to_say: Here you see our live network topology. Trains like T104 Superfast are moving in real-time based on actual physical kinematics over our NetworkX graph representation.
exact_3min_demo.technical_meaning: Replays telemetry ticks over directed graph edges with physical kinematic updates (T = D/V * 3600).

exact_3min_demo.action: Click '⚡ Block Dadar Fast Line' button
exact_3min_demo.expected_result: Red block icon appears at Dadar Junction. Train T104 halts. ML Panel switches to HIGH Risk (89% Prob). Conflict Radar alerts CONF-INC-01.
exact_3min_demo.what_to_say: Now, let's inject a sudden real-world disruption—a major track blockage on the Dadar Down Fast Line. Immediately, our ML Random Forest model detects high congestion risk (89% probability).
exact_3min_demo.technical_meaning: Sends POST /api/simulation/control with {action: 'block_track'}. Backend flags blockage, invokes Random Forest inference, and records conflict.

exact_3min_demo.expected_result: Solve notification fires (~142ms). ML Risk drops to LOW (8%). Conflict RESOLVED. Recommendation panel shows reroute via Down Slow Track.
exact_3min_demo.what_to_say: To resolve this bottleneck, we trigger our Google OR-Tools CP-SAT constraint solver. In under 150 milliseconds, CP-SAT re-evaluates all track occupancy constraints and reroutes T104 onto the Down Slow line with zero safety violations.
exact_3min_demo.technical_meaning: Sends POST /api/optimize. Backend executes StationTrafficOptimizer CP-SAT solver, computes optimal track allocations, and updates routes.

exact_3min_demo.action: Scroll to Before vs With AI panel; click Analytics tab
exact_3min_demo.expected_result: Before vs With AI panel shows +26.6% Throughput, -76.2% Delay. Analytics tab displays Validated 10-Train Benchmark (-40.41% hold time).
exact_3min_demo.what_to_say: As a result, system throughput increases by 26.6% and total waiting time drops by over 75%. On our validated 10-train benchmark, our infrastructure-aware solver reduced optimizer-added hold time by 40.41%.
exact_3min_demo.technical_meaning: Demonstrates dynamic derived metrics comparison and canonical validated 10-train benchmark results.

exact_3min_demo.expected_result: Data provenance audit table expands showing exact API endpoints, source files, and dataset classifications.
exact_3min_demo.what_to_say: Finally, our system maintains full data provenance and transparency. Every metric shown to you today is traced directly to open APIs, Scikit-Learn models, and OR-Tools solvers.
exact_3min_demo.technical_meaning: Displays interactive React audit accordion verifying scientific integrity and code tracing.

technical_data_flow.description: Selected trains JSON and station geographic coordinates (CSMT to Thane).
Constructs directed network graph of Mumbai Central Line corridor with station nodes and track edges.
1-second simulation tick advancing train positions along graph edges based on kinematic travel time formula T = (D/V) * 3600.
Scikit-Learn Random Forest Classifier evaluating 19 numerical & 7 categorical telemetry features to predict delay escalation probability.
Google OR-Tools CP-SAT constraint integer program minimizing weighted delay and optimizer holds while enforcing 60s/120s safety headway.
FastAPI web server providing REST API endpoints with thread-safe RLock state synchronization.
React TypeScript dashboard rendering interactive map, KPI cards, ML panel, CP-SAT visualizer, recommendations, and analytics.

metric_provenance.interpretation: Count of active train entities currently moving or halted on modeled corridor graph.
Estimated hourly train dispatch rate derived dynamically from average delay and active conflict penalties.
Mean delay across all active trains relative to scheduled arrival timetable.

metric_provenance.calculation_type: Calculated: min(98, max(30, round(70 + moving * 3.0 - conflicts * 5.0)))
metric_provenance.interpretation: Modeled track resource occupancy ratio based on active moving trains vs conflicts.

metric_provenance.calculation_type: Calculated: len([c for c in conflicts if c['status'] == 'DETECTED'])
metric_provenance.interpretation: Number of active track resource occupancy overlaps currently detected.
Random Forest predicted probability of delay escalation given current telemetry features.
Real CPU execution wall-clock time required by Google OR-Tools CP-SAT solver to compute optimal schedule.

metric_provenance.calculation_type: Measured offline benchmark sum across 10 trains
metric_provenance.interpretation: Total completion delay accumulated by legacy baseline scheduler across canonical 10-train dataset.

metric_provenance.calculation_type: Measured offline benchmark sum across 10 trains
metric_provenance.interpretation: Total completion delay achieved by infrastructure-aware CP-SAT solver across canonical 10-train dataset.
Reduction in unnecessary optimizer-introduced hold delays achieved by infrastructure-aware model.

scientific_credibility.random_forest_role: Evaluates 26 telemetry features to compute binary delay escalation probability y=1. Trained on master_dataset.csv (84.2% accuracy, 0.81 F1). Acts as early warning sensor.
scientific_credibility.or_tools_cpsat_role: Solves Constraint Integer Programming formulation minimizing total delay and optimizer holds while enforcing 60s/120s safety headway. Solves live scenario in ~142ms.
scientific_credibility.replayed_components: Historical Mumbai Central Line telemetry, train routes, station coordinates, and scheduled timetables.
scientific_credibility.simulated_components: Live 1-second kinematic train position updates, track blockage perturbation injections.
scientific_credibility.mathematically_derived_components: System Throughput, Average Delay, Track Utilization %, % Improvements.
scientific_credibility.prototype_assumptions: Single-block edge capacity, 60s/120s safety headway, 45 km/h fallback speed, 20s passenger halt dwell.
non_capabilities: No live CRIS/FOIS production API streaming connection
No physical interlocking or turnout motor control
Not certified for un-crewed autonomous operation

backup_plan.fallback_trigger: Client-side offline fallback ticker (clientFallbackTick in apiService.ts) automatically engages when backend is offline.
backup_plan.backup_demo_path: Point out offline mode badge, demonstrate offline ticker and ML/solver visualizers, and walk judges through the Validated 10-Train Benchmark panel on the Analytics tab.

final_summary.what_judge_sees: Modern dark-themed React dashboard with interactive railway map, KPI cards, ML risk gauges, CP-SAT visualizers, recommendations, and analytics.
final_summary.what_system_does: Replays telemetry, runs Random Forest inference, solves OR-Tools CP-SAT math optimization, and computes dynamic derived metrics.
